violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib
violation_type.typical_finding: The infant pack n plays had an added soft mattress. The added mattress did not come with the pack n plays.     Note: This was corrected at inspection.

finding_variants.text: The infant pack n plays had an added soft mattress. The added mattress did not come with the pack n plays.     Note: This was corrected at inspection.
Two cribs had additional foam padding underneath the mattress.
One crib in the 0-11 month classroom does not have a snugly fitting mattress.
In both of the Infant rooms there were several cribs that did not have a firm fitting mattress.
Two cribs were observed to have oversized mattresses that were not designed for the cribs.
A 7 month old infant was observed sleeping in a crib with two additional mattresses under the original mattress.

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: During the inspection I observed an infant with a pacifier attachment in the crib.    Note: This was corrected at the inspection.

Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: The crib mattresses were recently replaced with new ones that do not specifically match the crib model numbers.

Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation by the Department of Family and Protective Services and was found to be deficient as three children were observed sleeping in cribs without mattresses. A caregiver reported that the Director had removed the mattresses. This violates the requirement that all cribs must have a firm, flat mattress that snugly fits the sides of the crib and is specifically designed for use with the crib model number. The absence of mattresses compromises the safety and well-being of children and does not meet the required safety standards for cribs.

Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: Two infant cribs were observed having mattresses that were not a flat mattress that snugly fits the sides of each crib.  The sheets observed being used prevents the mattress to be flat and fit snugly on the sides of the crib.  This was corrected when the caregivers removed the sheets to change them during inspection.
